discovered_by: gate0-transfer while running team task-10 (parity tasks 2.4/2.5)
summary: The committed Windows realesrgan-worker release binary rejects every normal absolute path because it compares Path::canonicalize() to the input path, and on Windows Rust canonicalize returns an extended-length \?\C:\... path. Passing verbatim extended-length paths satisfies the comparison but the frozen ncnn executable cannot open them, so a real generation-v2 exchange cannot complete until the worker is fixed.

ncnn_bundle.note: ncnn exe and weights match the frozen manifest/worker constants; the same bundle passes the direct Gate 0 runs in verification/windows-parity-realesrgan/.

root_cause: tools/realesrgan-worker/src/main.rs normalizes paths with `path.canonicalize()? != path` in parse_binary(), validate_request() (model path and output dir). Rust std::fs::canonicalize on Windows returns the extended-length form `\\?\C:\...`, so the comparison always fails for a regular absolute path supplied by the installer / harness. This is a Windows portability defect of the native worker, not a model/runtime/budget failure.

reproductions.description: All worker inputs are ordinary normalized absolute paths.

observed.stderr: realesrgan worker: ncnn binary must be an absolute regular file named realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan.exe

reproductions.description: The harness prefixes the worker binary argument, model path, output dir and source path with \\?\ so the canonicalize comparison passes; the worker then starts real inference.

impact: Blocks the Real-ESRGAN Windows worker real protocol evidence (task-10 item 3) and would block the installed product worker on the target machine, because the installer passes the same normal absolute paths. No candidate was produced; the failure is a worker path-normalization defect, not a budget failure.
fix_proposal: Normalize before comparing: accept the path when it is an absolute, non-symlink regular file/dir and its canonical form equals the input after stripping the Windows `\\?\` prefix case-insensitively (the existing macOS behavior is unchanged). Keep the ncnn argv `-i/-o/-m` paths un-prefixed (normal absolute paths) because the frozen ncnn binary cannot open extended-length paths. Add unit tests for both normal and verbatim inputs and rebuild the release binary.
next_step: desktop-install fixes tools/realesrgan-worker, rebuilds the release binary and verifies one 97x61 real exchange; then this task reruns the official 220x220 and 97x61 v2 exchanges and replaces this failure record with passing real-protocol evidence.
